演示模式无需语言包: Demo mode needs no language pack
没看到下载面板的话，去 系统设置 → 通用 → 语言与地区 → 翻译语言，手动添: If you don't see the download panel, go to System Settings → General → Language & Region → Translation Languages and add the language there.
语言包已安装，重启一次识别后生效。: Language pack installed. Restart recognition once to apply.
语言包尚未下载：点上面的按钮，在系统面板里确认下载: Language pack not downloaded yet. Press the button above and confirm the download in the system panel.
这台设备不支持这个语言对: This device doesn't support this language pair
当前模型不在列表里，仍可手动填写。: The current model isn't in the list. You can still type it in.
没有麦克风权限。请到系统设置中允许 Transclase 使用麦克风。: No microphone access. Allow Transclase to use the microphone in System Settings.
找不到可用的麦克风。请检查音频输入设备。: No microphone available. Check your audio input devices.
无法在麦克风格式和识别模型格式之间转换。: Can't convert between microphone and speech model formats.
最快，完全离线，需要下载语言包: Fastest, fully offline, needs language packs
离线，可注入上下文，需要先在本机跑起模型: Offline with context, requires a local model server
质量最好，需要联网和自己填 API Key: Best quality, needs network and an API key
翻译引擎地址无效，已改用系统翻译。: The engine endpoint is invalid, so system translation is used instead.
离线语言包还没下载，先只显示原文。到设置里点“下载语言包”即可开启翻译。: The offline language pack isn't downloaded yet, so only the source text is shown. Download it in Settings to turn on translation.
此设备不支持系统语音识别模型。: System speech recognition isn't supported on this device.
翻译会话尚未就绪，请稍候再试。: Translation isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.
这些模型由系统统一管理，App 无法单独删除。磁盘紧张时系统会自动清理长期未用的: These models are managed by the system, so the app can't delete them individually. The system removes models that haven't been used for a while when disk space runs low.
点「新对话」开始一节课: Start a lecture with New session
或者直接点下面的麦克风。声音只在本机处理。: Or press the microphone below. Audio never leaves this device.
演示模式：会播放一段模拟讲座: Demo mode plays a simulated lecture
这台设备没有可用的系统语音识别，可以先试试演示模式: System speech recognition isn't available on this device. Try demo mode instead.
首次使用需要联网下载一次，约 400 MB。装好后上课全程离线。: First run downloads about 400 MB once. After that everything is offline.
界面语言会在下次启动时生效。: The interface language takes effect on next launch.
先跑起来：ollama pull qwen3.5:2b 然后 ollama se: Get started with ollama pull qwen3.5:2b, then ollama serve.
地址需要以 /v1 结尾。翻译引擎选「云端 API」和翻译助手都用这一份配置。: The endpoint must end with /v1. Both the cloud engine and the assistant use this configuration.
译文按完整句子输出：识别碎片会先攒成一句，遇到句号或停顿再翻译。代价是最后一句会: Translations are emitted as whole sentences: recognised fragments are collected into a sentence and translated at a full stop or pause. The last sentence is 1–2 seconds behind.
音频只在本机内存中处理。开启云端翻译或助手后，识别出的文字会发送到所配置的服务商: Audio is processed in memory on this device. When cloud translation or the assistant is enabled, recognised text is sent to the configured provider. Check your school's policy and local law before recording a lecture.
